name: Issue Logger
highlights: Team issue tracker in Next.js, Prisma and PostgreSQL: projects with short keys (API-42), Owner/Admin/Member/Viewer roles re-checked on every server action, a drag-and-drop board and a filterable list with bulk edits.
Error ingestion API: services report crashes with a hashed API key, repeats are grouped by fingerprint, and an error that returns after it was fixed reopens its issue as a regression.
Signed (HMAC-SHA256) webhooks to Slack, Discord or any endpoint, delivered through a transactional outbox with retries and backoff, plus per-person email notifications.
SLA clocks with at-risk and breach alerts, velocity forecasts and an insights dashboard; email-verified accounts with session revocation, a ⌘K palette and keyboard shortcuts.

decisions.choice: Deliver webhooks through a transactional outbox with retries and backoff
decisions.because: A slow or failing endpoint can't block or lose the change that triggered it.

decisions.choice: Store API keys only as SHA-256 hashes, shown once
decisions.because: A leaked database doesn't hand out working keys.

decisions.choice: Group errors by title (digits ignored) plus the top stack frame
decisions.because: "timeout after 3012ms" and "timeout after 2990ms" land on the same issue.
